name: Test Coverage Gate
description: Warns if test coverage drops below a configurable threshold after running tests, helping maintain code quality standards
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Check test coverage after test runs
COMMAND="$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND"
THRESHOLD=${CLAUDE_COVERAGE_THRESHOLD:-80}
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE '(vitest|jest|pytest|coverage)'; then
  # Look for coverage output
  COVERAGE_FILE="coverage/coverage-summary.json"
  ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo ".")
  if [[ -f "$ROOT/$COVERAGE_FILE" ]]; then
    TOTAL=$(cat "$ROOT/$COVERAGE_FILE" | grep -o '"lines":{"total":[0-9]*,"covered":[0-9]*' | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$TOTAL" ]]; then
      LINES_TOTAL=$(echo "$TOTAL" | grep -o 'total":[0-9]*' | grep -o '[0-9]*')
      LINES_COVERED=$(echo "$TOTAL" | grep -o 'covered":[0-9]*' | grep -o '[0-9]*')
      if [[ $LINES_TOTAL -gt 0 ]]; then
        PCT=$((LINES_COVERED * 100 / LINES_TOTAL))
        if [[ $PCT -lt $THRESHOLD ]]; then
          echo "WARNING: Test coverage is ${PCT}% (threshold: ${THRESHOLD}%). Add more tests."
        fi
      fi
    fi
  fi
fi
exit 0
